findings.title: CodeQL rust/cleartext-logging: Cleartext logging of sensitive information
findings.reason: false positive — The flagged line inserts a gcloud account e-mail and an active flag into the list returned to the connection wizard (from 'gcloud config list'/'gcloud auth list'); no token or secret is read there and nothing is logged.

findings.title: CodeQL rust/cleartext-storage-database: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in a database
findings.reason: false positive — with_password is a catalog query that returns only the boolean 'a.rolpassword IS NOT NULL' (whether a role has a password) to list users; no password or hash is read, sent or stored.

findings.title: CodeQL rust/cleartext-storage-database: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in a database
findings.reason: false positive — The flagged values are a numeric MySQL connection id (session_id parses to u64) and quoted account names (user@host) sent as SQL to the user's own database for KILL/user-management statements; no secret is stored by DBine there.

findings.title: CodeQL rust/cleartext-transmission: Cleartext transmission of sensitive information
findings.reason: false positive — ep.accounts comes from Endpoints::of, which always builds https:// URLs from Zoho's fixed data-centre hosts, and every production client for these calls is built with https_only(true) and no redirects; http:// endpoints appear only in the in-test mock server.

findings.title: CodeQL rust/cleartext-transmission: Cleartext transmission of sensitive information
findings.reason: false positive — revoke_with is called only with an accounts base built as format!("https://{host}") from Zoho's fixed host list and through zoho::https_client(), which sets https_only(true) and disables redirects; the http:// bases exist only in the test mock server.

findings.title: CodeQL rust/hard-coded-cryptographic-value: Hard-coded cryptographic value
findings.reason: false positive — Not a password: the public Microsoft Entra sign-in host URL (login.microsoftonline.com) used to build OAuth and realm-discovery URLs.
